key_insight: Aeneas extracts pure Lean models from production Rust code, letting Lean verify cryptographic software without low-level pointer and aliasing reasoning.
engineering_relevance: The approach shows that verified Rust can still satisfy real-world needs for performance, portability, deployment, and maintainability in a production cryptographic provider.
method: Target Rust cryptographic implementations with Aeneas to obtain a pure model in Lean.
Use Lean tactics and libraries to prove safety, panic-freedom, and functional correctness.
Employ AI agents to draft proofs and assist with standards and intrinsics formalization, with Lean kernel verification.
evidence_signal: The project reports a 237KLOC Lean development verifying 16.7KLOC of Rust code across post-quantum cipher suites for x86-64 and ARM.
watch_item: Formalizing cryptographic standards and platform-specific intrinsics still needs expert design and careful review.
paper_title: Scaling Verification of Cryptographic Software with Aeneas, Rust, and Lean
